name: log-follower
description: Keeps a growing log file scrolled to its tail in the editor, and yields the moment you take control of the tab.

commands.title: Log Follower: Toggle auto-scroll for this file
Log Follower: Start auto-scroll for this file
Log Follower: Stop auto-scroll for this file

logFollower.autoFollowGlobs.description: File-name patterns (simple * wildcards) followed automatically when opened. Matching is on the file name only, so no machine-specific path is needed.

logFollower.coalesceMs.description: How often the followed file is polled for growth, in milliseconds (400 = 2.5 checks/second). Each check is one file stat, and only an actual size change costs a revert/scroll, so this interval is the floor of the follow's cost. Raise it to reduce cost further. Changing it needs a window reload: the interval is created once at activation.
